items.evidence: data/general/objects/egos/mindstars.lua:737-749 binds the sole placeholder to mind damage and grants both psi and hate as damage/10; the target preserves range 10 and both 10% gains.
data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:4524-4528 binds %d to cold damDesc and computes damage from Magic; the target preserves the summoned wisp, explosion, damage type and scaling.

data/talents/chronomancy/other.lua:900-937 binds temporal then physical half-damage, applies a 1.5 multiplier for either destabilization, and attempts instakill below 20%; the target preserves order and conditions.

data/talents/chronomancy/spellbinding.lua:86-95 describes only duration extension and binds %d then the selected spell name. The target adds a generic strengthening claim, calls a spell a skill, contains the malformed phrase ‘时空增效系效果’, and labels the selected value as a generic strengthened spell rather than the extended spell.
